pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for intermediate to advanced (B1-C2) English students who want to improve their skills in all aspects of language (reading, writing, listening, and speaking). This class is ideal for students who want to prepare for exams such as IELTS which include a writing section.

What will my lesson be like?

• Before our lesson, you will select and complete a homework assignment from my website. These assignments cover a wide range of topics and are based on authentic video material (news reports, TED Talks, interviews, etc.).  After watching the video, you will answer comprehension questions, complete vocabulary exercises, and write a 3+ paragraph essay on the topic. Homework is required and should be submitted at least a day before the lesson time. 

• During our Zoom meeting, we will analyze your essay and complete grammar/vocabulary exercises based completely on the errors in your essay. By using your essay as the basis of our lesson, I will be able to efficiently identify gaps in your knowledge and avoid wasting time on learning things you've already mastered.  After we finish working through your essay, we will continue discussing the topic in greater depth through an authentic text.

• Students will receive a password to access the homework platform before the lesson. An individual Google Doc with class notes & corrections will be sent to each student. 

[If you do NOT want to work on reading/writing or receive homework please choose "Informal Tutoring" instead. If the student does not submit an assignment before class, a "Guided Conversation" class will be taught instead. All classes are conducted on Zoom.]

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching philosophy: I firmly believe that ANY person can learn ANY language. I also believe that people today don’t just learn by reading, but also by observing, watching, interacting and discussing.

Variety: A bored student doesn't learn, so I like to keep things interesting by talking about topics that are important to YOU.
